# Reference: the rule file

<!-- Written by docs/tools/gen-reference.php from src/Rules/Reference.php -- do not edit; run the tool. -->

Every rule a rule file may hold, what it sets, and the feature it belongs to. How the file works -- blocks, sites, IDs, includes -- is in [rule files](../features/RSF05-01-rule-files.md); `request-shield vocabulary` prints the same.

| Rule | Setting | Feature | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `host <names>` | `hosts` | [RSF02-01](../features/RSF02-01-hard-rejects.md) | the site's hosts; others 404 |
| `trust <addresses or ranges>` | `trustedProxies` | [RSF01-01](../features/RSF01-01-trusted-proxies.md) | who may send `X-Forwarded-*` |
| `method <METHODS>` | `methods` | [RSF02-01](../features/RSF02-01-hard-rejects.md) | methods allowed at all |
| `allow <METHODS> <paths>` | `methodPaths` | [RSF02-03](../features/RSF02-03-access-rules.md) | those methods only there, else 405 ([access rules](../features/RSF02-03-access-rules.md)) |
| `restrict <paths> to <addresses or ranges>` | `restricted` | [RSF02-03](../features/RSF02-03-access-rules.md) | only those addresses, else 403 ([access rules](../features/RSF02-03-access-rules.md)) |
| `block <paths>` / `unblock <paths>` | `blockedPaths` | RSF02-02 | 404 before the site sees it / take a block back |
| `block query\|header <Name>\|headers\|anywhere <regex>` | `contentRules` | RSF02-02 | attack patterns in the query or the headers, 403 |
| `unblock [<what>] at <paths> [for <addresses>]` | `blockExceptions` | RSF02-02 | blocked paths let through at some paths only (an admin's file reader) ([access rules](../features/RSF02-03-access-rules.md#exceptions-an-admins-file-reader)) |
| `query <name> <type> … [at <paths>]` / `query strict` | `queryParams`, `queryStrict` | [RSF02-05](../features/RSF02-05-known-parameters.md) | the query parameters the site takes and their types (`int`, `number`, `word`, `id`, `list`, `text`, `any`, `/regex/`); only `text` and the unknown ones go to the attack patterns; `strict`: anything else 404 ([known parameters](../features/RSF02-05-known-parameters.md)) |
| `cache-path <paths>` | `cacheable.paths` | [RSF04-01](../features/RSF04-01-cacheable-definition.md) | what a cache may keep; `any`: every path (default) |
| `cache-query <names>` | `cacheable.query` | [RSF04-01](../features/RSF04-01-cacheable-definition.md) | parameters a cached URL may have; `any` (default), `none` |
| `limit <name> <n>/<unit> [challenge-at <n>] [on-demand] [on-exceeded challenge] [at <paths>]` | `budgets` | [RSF03-01](../features/RSF03-01-budgets.md) | units `s`, `sec`, `min`, `hour`, `day`, also `20/10s`; `on-exceeded challenge`: past the limit the check that frees the counter instead of a pause ([budgets](../features/RSF03-01-budgets.md#past-the-limit-a-pause-or-earn-it-back)); `at <paths>` (or inside a `match` block): only requests there count ([an area's budget](../features/RSF03-01-budgets.md#a-budget-for-one-area)) |
| `post-origin same [missing check\|allow\|refuse] [except <paths>]` / `post-origin except <paths>` | `postOrigin` | [RSF02-04](../features/RSF02-04-forms-from-the-website.md) | forms (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) only from the website's own pages: `Origin`, else `Referer`; another website 403, neither the browser check ([forms from the website](../features/RSF02-04-forms-from-the-website.md)) |
| `backend <paths>` | `backend` | [RSF06-03](../features/RSF06-03-statistics.md) | the editors' area: its forms counted apart in the statistics, one entry per area ([forms in the statistics](../features/RSF06-03-statistics.md#forms-sent-from-where-how-they-ended)); inside a `match` block without paths |
| `api-path <paths>` | `challenge.apiPaths` | [RSF03-02](../features/RSF03-02-browser-challenge.md) | the site's API: a check there is JSON with a header, not a page |
| `no-limit <name>` | `budgets` | [RSF03-01](../features/RSF03-01-budgets.md) | switch a budget off, the default one too |
| `challenge <paths> [max-age <duration>]` | `challenge.alwaysPaths`, `challenge.alwaysMaxAge` | [RSF03-02](../features/RSF03-02-browser-challenge.md) | always check the browser there; `max-age 5m`: a pass from the last five minutes there ([modes](../features/RSF05-03-modes.md)) |
| `monitor <rule>` | `monitorRules` | [RSF05-03](../features/RSF05-03-modes.md) | before `block`, `restrict`, `allow`, `limit`, `challenge`, `ban`, `feed`, `query strict`: logged as it would decide, not enforced ([modes](../features/RSF05-03-modes.md)) |
| `stats-group "<name>" <websites>` | `ext.stats.groups` | [RSF06-03](../features/RSF06-03-statistics.md) | websites of one customer, read together and each on its own; counted apart without naming them in `stats-hosts`; above the site blocks ([groups](../features/RSF06-03-statistics.md#groups-websites-per-customer)) |
| `dashboard-access "<principal>"\|* sha256:<hash> [until <day>]` | `dashboardAccess` | [RSF06-01](../features/RSF06-01-active-rules-page.md) | who may open the dashboard: the admin (`*`) or a principal (a customer's group in the statistics); only the token's hash (`bin/request-shield access-token`); above the site blocks ([who sees what](../features/RSF06-03-statistics.md#who-sees-what-tokens-a-login-signed-links)) |
| `stats-skip <paths>` | `ext.stats.skip` | [RSF06-03](../features/RSF06-03-statistics.md) | not in the statistics when they pass (a map proxy's tiles); refused or checked they are counted; protected all the same ([statistics](../features/RSF06-03-statistics.md#paths-that-are-not-counted-stats-skip)) |
| `challenge-exempt <paths>` | `challenge.exemptPaths` | [RSF03-02](../features/RSF03-02-browser-challenge.md) | never challenge there (APIs, feeds) |
| `exempt <addresses or ranges> [until <day>[T<hh:mm>]]` | `exempt.ips` | [RSF01-02](../features/RSF01-02-ip-lists.md) | never counted and never checked, still refused for blocked paths and attack patterns ([IP lists](../features/RSF01-02-ip-lists.md)) |
| `deny <addresses or ranges> [until <day>[T<hh:mm>]]` | `deny` | [RSF01-02](../features/RSF01-02-ip-lists.md) | kept out: 403 before every other check ([IP lists](../features/RSF01-02-ip-lists.md)) |
| `feed <name> [<https-url>] deny\|check\|count\|ban-signal <n> [at <paths>] [format <f>] [wide-ok]` | `feeds` | [RSF01-03](../features/RSF01-03-blocklist-feeds.md) | a public blocklist, fetched by `request-shield feeds … update`; above the site blocks ([feeds](../features/RSF01-03-blocklist-feeds.md)) |
| `ban after <n> <signal> in <time> for <time>` | `bans` | [RSF01-02](../features/RSF01-02-ip-lists.md) | a client past `<n>` signals (`limits`, `refusals`, `checks`, a budget's name) is answered only 429 for a while; above the site blocks ([IP lists](../features/RSF01-02-ip-lists.md#bans)) |
| `crawlers <kind> allow\|check\|block` / `crawler <ID> allow\|check\|block` | `crawlerPolicy` | [RSF01-04](../features/RSF01-04-known-crawlers.md) | what the site does with verified crawlers, by kind (`search`, `ai-search`, `ai-user`, `ai-training`) or one by one ([known crawlers](../features/RSF01-04-known-crawlers.md)) |
| `crawler <kind> ua /<pattern>/ [dns <suffixes>] [ranges <lists>]` | `crawlers` | [RSF01-04](../features/RSF01-04-known-crawlers.md) | a crawler of the site's own, verified by DNS or an address list (`ranges ./ours.json`) |
| `expect <METHOD> <address> <outcome> [by <ID>] [from <address>] [with pass] [times <n>]` | — | [RSF05-04](../features/RSF05-04-rule-examples.md) | an example of what the rules decide, below the rule it is about; decided by `request-shield test`, never by a request ([examples](../features/RSF05-04-rule-examples.md)) |
| `match <paths> { … }` | — | [RSF05-01](../features/RSF05-01-rule-files.md) | the rules of an area in one place: the lines inside apply to its paths only ([match blocks](../features/RSF05-01-rule-files.md#match-blocks-the-rules-of-an-area-in-one-place)) |
| `site <names> { … }` | `sites` | [RSF05-01](../features/RSF05-01-rule-files.md) | rules for some websites, added to the base ([site blocks](../features/RSF05-01-rule-files.md#site-blocks-rules-per-website)) |
| `ids <PREFIX> [required]` | — | [RSF05-05](../features/RSF05-05-log-and-rule-ids.md) | the namespace of this file's IDs; `required`: every rule needs one ([IDs](../features/RSF05-01-rule-files.md#ids-namespaces-and-descriptions)) |
| `version <version>` | — | [RSF05-01](../features/RSF05-01-rule-files.md) | this file's own version, shown by `check` and on the rules page ([versions](../features/RSF05-01-rule-files.md#versions-revisions-and-replacing-a-rule)) |
| `replace [<ID>] <rule>` | — | [RSF05-01](../features/RSF05-01-rule-files.md) | a rule swapped in one line, keeping its ID -- and its count in the log ([replacing](../features/RSF05-01-rule-files.md#versions-revisions-and-replacing-a-rule)) |
| `plugin <class> [from <file>]` | `plugins`, `pluginFiles` | [RSF06-04](../features/RSF06-04-plugins.md) | a [plugin](../features/RSF06-04-plugins.md), told what was decided and how a request ended; `from` names the file that holds the class, relative to the rule file, for a site without Composer (loaded when the rules are compiled and when the shield makes its plugins); the statistics need none (`set stats on`); a class that is an [extension](../features/RSF06-04-plugins.md#extensions-words-and-settings-of-their-own) brings words and `set` keys of its own, known from its `plugin` line on |
| `set <key> <value>` | any other setting | [RSF05-02](../features/RSF05-02-settings.md) | see below |
| `include <path or glob>` | — | [RSF05-01](../features/RSF05-01-rule-files.md) | further rule files, relative to this one |
